title: Ranji Trophy 2026: Australian umpire Ben Treloar to officiate two matches
description:
Australian umpire Ben Treloar will officiate in two Ranji Trophy matches, while India's Parashar Joshi will travel Down Under to stand in two Sheffield Shield matches and one One Day Cup fixture as part of an exchange programme between the governing bodies of the two countries.
Treloar will officiate Delhi's Ranji Trophy match against Gujarat from October 18 to 21 in Delhi before standing in Mumbai's clash with Haryana from October 26 to 29 in Mumbai, a Cricket Australia release stated.
Meanhwhile, Joshi's Australian exchange will begin with Queensland's Sheffield Shield match against Tasmania at the Gabba from November 11 to 14.
He will then officiate in the sides' One Day Cup fixture at the same venue on November 16 before completing the program in the Sheffield Shield clash between New South Wales and Queensland at the SCG from November 22 to 25.
